chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Amir ibn 'Umayr and Sa'id al-A'raj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Go to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) once a year.
ai.seo_question: How often should one visit the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarah* establishes the annual visitation to Imam al-Husayn’s shrine as a recommended minimum (mustahabb), reflecting the enduring spiritual bond between the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers. It underscores the theological importance of maintaining a continuous connection with the martyr of Karbala, serving as a yearly renewal of covenant and love (mawaddah) for both the wealthy and the poor.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from ‘Āmir ibn ‘Umayr, and from Sa’īd Al-A’raj, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) once a year.
